author: ABC-Belarus
title: ABC-Belarus lost its hoster Autistici/Inventati because of American fascists
content:
Back in 2010, at the height of the repression, one of our comrades contacted us and proposed setting up a website for our group. At the time, Italian activists from Autistici became our hosters. For a small annual donation, they handled the technical infrastructure, allowing us to focus on our work. Sixteen years later, we find ourselves in a situation where Donald Trump’s fascist politics affect not only collectives in the US or Europe, but also our own struggle.

Even before ABC-Belarus came into existence, the Autistici collective had been a target of the Italian government: they were persecuted for supporting the local Anarchist Black Cross group. At the time, the Italian authorities hacked activists’ servers as part of a criminal investigation. After we began working with Autistici, we learned that unknown hackers from Belarus had also tried to hack the service, but failed. In 2015, through our collaboration with the group, we learned about the hacking of the Italian company Hacking Team’s servers and its possible cooperation with the Belarusian regime.

In August 2026, the Trump administration added the Autistici/Inventati collective to its list of terrorist organizations for providing infrastructure to antifascist and anarchist groups and organizations.
